ticket.slBeyondLiquidation: This stop sits at or beyond the liquidation price. It can never trigger — the position liquidates first.
ticket.haltedNote: Routing is halted platform-wide. Closing an open position still works.
ticket.noAccounts: No account can take this order. Connect one, or resume a paused one.
ticket.alreadyOpen: A trade is already open. Each account commits 99% of its balance, so only one runs at a time — close it first.
ticket.sltpRequired: Stop loss and take profit are both required. They are sent to the exchange with the order — an entry at leverage never goes out unprotected.
ticket.amendsLive: A trade is open: changing the stop or target here sends the amendment to every account at once.

position.unprotected: {n} filled leg(s) carry no stop. Amend the SL/TP or close them.
position.flatBody: Send an order and every account's own position appears here, marked to the live price.
position.confirmCloseBody: This market-closes {symbol} on all {n} accounts holding it, at once — and any other trade still open. It cannot be undone.
position.sltpRequired: A stop loss and a take profit are both required: an amend replaces the protection resting on the exchange, so leaving one blank would remove it.
position.otherOpenTrades: {n} more trade(s) are open on other accounts and are not shown here. Close flattens those too.
position.staleHint: This exchange still rests on the previous stop or target — the amendment did not land here.
position.staleLegs: {n} account(s) still rest on the previous stop or target. The amendment did not reach them.

finance.emptyBody: Connect an account before recording cash flows.

detect.title: Unexplained balance changes
detect.subtitle: The platform works out what each one was — the trade, or somebody's cash — and books it. Only what it could not call waits here.
detect.dismissBody: Nothing is recorded and nothing is credited to the trade. Use this only when the change was an exchange artefact.
detect.dismissPlaceholder: Why this is neither a trade result nor a transfer
detect.question: What was this?
detect.classTradeHint: Nothing is recorded. Invested capital stays as it is and the change shows up in PnL.
detect.classInvestorHint: Recorded as a cash flow. Invested capital changes, so PnL does not count it.

reason.emptied: The account was emptied — nobody trades a balance to nothing.
reason.funded_from_empty: The account had nothing in it and now has money.
reason.no_trade: Nothing traded on this account anywhere near the change, so there is no trade it could have come from.
reason.isolated: Only this account moved. {peers} other accounts were readable and sat still — a trade would have moved all of them.
reason.portfolio_wide: {moved} of {peers} other accounts moved the same way at the same moment. That is a fan-out, not {moved} people transferring at once.
reason.trade_residual: Small next to the trade's own result — fees, funding and the exchange's rounding.
reason.unclear: Nothing settled it either way, so the standing default applies: a balance that moves on a trading account moved because of the trade.

detect.amountHint: Change the figure if you know the real one.
detect.decidedHint: {n} recent changes the platform called by itself. Change any of them if it got one wrong.
detect.emptyBody: Every balance change so far was either a trade the platform placed or a transfer it recognised.

split.title: Profit split
split.hint: The profit on every account is divided by these global percentages. On a loss there is nothing to divide — the loss is the PnL.

group.sizingHint: How much of each account goes into a trade.
group.sltpHint: How SL/TP percentages are read, applied and repaired.

diagHint.socket: WebSocket to the execution engine. Order routing still works over REST while it is down.
diagHint.latency: Measured round trip from this browser to the engine. On a local network it is a millisecond, which says nothing about reaching an exchange.
diagHint.exchangeLatency: Measured round trip from the engine to the price provider — the hop an order actually travels, and the one that spends the fan-out deadline. Blank when nothing was measured in the last minute.
diagHint.feed: Which exchange the chart prices came from. Every price shown is an exchange's; when none is reachable the panel shows no price at all.

settings.legalNote: This platform routes real trades for other people’s capital. Depending on your jurisdiction and how any fee or profit share is structured, that can require registration or a licence. Confirm with a qualified professional before connecting real partner accounts.

login.title: Sign in
login.lede: The panel routes real orders, so it is staff-only.
login.note: No account yet? Create one on the server:

landing.lede: Entry, stop, target, close — each one goes out to every connected account at the same moment, sized to that account's own balance. When one exchange fails, the rest still fill and you get told which one didn't.

diagram.real: Your last trade, leg by leg
diagram.demo: Illustration — connect an account to see your own

isolation.body: Every account gets its own connection, its own rate limit and its own deadline. An exchange going down costs that account the trade and nobody else.

sizing.body: Every account commits 99% of its own USDT. A $50 account and a $5,000 account take the same leverage and the same stop percentage, at very different dollar sizes.

stops.body: Drag the stop on the chart, edit it in the ticket, or change it on the position row — all three push the same amendment to every account.

connect.body: Each account is verified on connect and refused outright if the key can withdraw. Keys are encrypted at rest and never returned to the browser.

trade.body: One ticket sets side, leverage and the stop and target percentages. The engine sizes each account from its own balance and dispatches every leg concurrently.

watch.body: Per-leg results arrive as they happen. A failed leg raises a notice that stays on screen until you dismiss it — no toast that disappears while you look away.

coverage.title: Eight exchanges behind one interface
coverage.body: Every exchange implements the same adapter, so capability differences — native versus emulated stops, per-symbol versus per-account leverage — are handled behind the seam rather than in trading logic. Adapters are written from vendored documentation and unit-tested; none has yet been run against a live exchange, so verify on testnet before committing real capital.

security.title: It holds live trading credentials
security.body: Keys are encrypted at rest with rotatable Fernet keys, never logged, never included in an API response, and verified as non-withdrawable at connect time wherever the exchange exposes a permission endpoint. Where it cannot be proven, the account is flagged rather than silently trusted.

landing.footerNote: Order routing and execution. Not an exchange, not a signal service.

connection.exchangeUnmeasured: No exchange round trip measured in the last minute.

down.idle: Not started — the panel has not opened the channel yet.
down.unreachable: The engine did not complete the handshake. The panel's own origin serves /ws; check that whatever terminates TLS forwards the Upgrade header.
down.forbidden: The engine refused this session. The live channel is staff-only — sign in as a staff account.
down.engine: The panel reached the engine but the engine did not answer. Check the backend container.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.invalid: That does not look like a pair — letters and digits only, e.g. AVAXUSDT.
watchlist.full: The list holds {n} pairs. Remove one first.

toast.closePartial: The position was NOT closed on every account — the exchange still holds it. Check the failure notices and try again.

logs.title: System Log
logs.subtitle: Every backend event as it is written — trades, exchanges, engine decisions and errors. Newest first.
logs.pruneBody: Permanently deletes every log entry older than {n} days. This cannot be undone.
logs.pruneInvalid: Keep at least one day — 0 would delete the whole log.
logs.exportHint: Save the rows currently shown, with the active filters, as JSON
logs.noEntriesBody: Nothing has been logged yet. Route an order or connect an account and this fills up.
logs.noMatchBody: Only the loaded page is searched here; older entries may still match.
logs.trimmedHint: The live tail is capped in the browser; the oldest live rows were dropped. Refresh to reload from the server.
logs.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
logs.traceHint: Show every entry from this request
